![Bucks v OKC NBA Cup Analyses](pics/NBA_cup.jpg)
```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(ggforce)
library(dplyr)
```
The NBA cup this past year was played against a team who, in regular season, had the highest offensive rating in the NBA (compared to our no.11). What changed within the NBA cup that caused our success?
```{r import data, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
shots <- read_csv("data_mil_okc_121724_shots(in).csv")

str(shots)
```

Shot Quality vs. Shot Success
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>%
  group_by(team_nba_off) %>%
  summarise(avg_qSQ = mean(qSQ, na.rm = TRUE),
            actual_fg_pct = mean(fg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_qSQ))
```

Though we had nearly identical shot quality, the gap in actual field goal percentage says one of two things: exceptional Bucks defense or cold shooting from OKC.

Catch-and-shoot Effectiveness
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>%
  group_by(catchAndShoot) %>%
  summarise(fg_pct = mean(fg, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_qSQ = mean(qSQ, na.rm = TRUE),
            attempts = n())
```

Defensive Contest
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>%
  group_by(contestLevel) %>%
  summarise(fg_pct = mean(fg, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_qSQ = mean(qSQ, na.rm = TRUE),
            attempts = n()) %>%
  arrange(fg_pct)

```

The fact that heavily contested shots still had some conversion (34.6%) shows how OKC still got decent chances—but our contesting suppressed quality (avg qSQ only 44.0).

Speed and Success
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>%
  mutate(speed_bin = cut(shooterSpeed, breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 6, 10, Inf), 
                         labels = c("Slow", "Moderate", "Fast", "Very Fast", "Insane"))) %>%
  group_by(speed_bin) %>%
  summarise(fg_pct = mean(fg, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_qSQ = mean(qSQ, na.rm = TRUE),
            attempts = n())
```

This suggests we succeeded on fast breaks or quick decisions, while OKC’s slower setups didn’t yield returns, even when shot quality was good. (i.e. the classic Shai mid-range pull up's only converting at 30% compared to his season's 50%)

Court Region and Shot Type
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots%>%
  group_by(team_nba_off, region) %>%
  summarise(fg_pct = mean(fg, na.rm = TRUE),
            attempts = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(fg_pct))
```

We were extremely effective from high-value zones, (e.i., Left wing three, Right corner three ,Restricted area (RA)

In contrast, OKC underperformed in their strongholds:RA: 40%, Key: 45.8%, Middle two: 50% on just 6 shots

This means we didn’t just shoot better, we shot better from smarter, higher value areas.


Plots
```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
ggplot(shots, aes(x = loc_x, y = loc_y, color = factor(fg))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  coord_fixed() +
  facet_wrap(~team_nba_off) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "red", "1" = "green"), labels = c("Miss", "Make")) +
  labs(title = "Shot Chart by Team", x = "Court X", y = "Court Y", color = "Shot Result") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r function for the court, echo=FALSE}
draw_half_court <- function() {
  court_theme <- theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  court <- ggplot() +
    # Court elements
    geom_circle(aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r = 7.5), color = "gray") +   # Rim area
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -8, xmax = 8, ymin = 0, ymax = 19), fill = NA, color = "gray") + # Paint
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -25, xmax = 25, ymin = -5, ymax = 47), fill = NA, color = "black") + # Court border
    geom_circle(aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 19, r = 6), color = "gray") + # Free throw
    geom_segment(aes(x = -22, y = 0, xend = -22, yend = 14), color = "gray") + # 3pt line
    geom_segment(aes(x = 22, y = 0, xend = 22, yend = 14), color = "gray") +
    geom_curve(aes(x = -22, y = 14, xend = 22, yend = 14),
               curvature = -1, color = "gray") +
    coord_fixed() +
    court_theme
  return(court)
}

draw_half_court_layers <- function() {
  list(
    geom_circle(aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r = 7.5), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "gray"),   # Rim
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -8, xmax = 8, ymin = 0, ymax = 19), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, color = "gray"),  # Paint
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -25, xmax = 25, ymin = -5, ymax = 47), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, color = "black"),  # Border
    geom_circle(aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 19, r = 6), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "gray"),  # Free throw
    geom_segment(aes(x = -22, y = 0, xend = -22, yend = 14), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "gray"),  # 3pt sides
    geom_segment(aes(x = 22, y = 0, xend = 22, yend = 14), inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "gray"),
    geom_curve(aes(x = -22, y = 14, xend = 22, yend = 14), inherit.aes = FALSE, curvature = -1, color = "gray"),  # 3pt arc
    coord_fixed(),
    theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
      )
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
draw_half_court() +
  geom_point(data = shots, aes(x = loc_x, y = loc_y, color = factor(fg)),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "red", "1" = "green")) +
  labs(title = "Shot Map with Court Overlay", color = "Shot Made")

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>% 
  filter(team_nba_off %in% c("MIL")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = loc_x, y = loc_y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(fg)), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "red", "1" = "green")) +
  labs(title = "Bucks Shots", color = "Shot Made") +
  draw_half_court_layers()

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>% 
  filter(team_nba_off %in% c("OKC")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = loc_x, y = loc_y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(fg)), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "red", "1" = "green")) +
  labs(title = "OKC Shots", color = "Shot Made") +
  draw_half_court_layers()
```

Heat Map
```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>%
  filter(team_nba_off %in% c("MIL", "OKC")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = loc_x, y = loc_y)) +
  geom_density_2d_filled(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~team_nba_off) +
  draw_half_court_layers() +
  labs(title = "Shot Density: Bucks vs. OKC") +
  theme_minimal()
```

From the heat map and bar chart, we can draw that OKC had greater diversity in their shot selection; many more types of shots fell for them. However, we had noticeably higher catch and shoot makes and catch and shoot makes with a relocation, indicating that OKC has trouble defending a player when moving to a different spot to shoot from.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
shots %>% 
  filter(team_nba_off %in% c("MIL", "OKC")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = complexShotType, fill = team_nba_off))+
  geom_bar( position = 'dodge')+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("green", "blue"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Conclusions 

We seemed to have optimized our help-defense and closeout structure:
Maintaining high contest frequency without sacrificing defensive integrity. This implies a high-IQ rotation scheme and strong communication.
